name: [UPD] Fishing Master
desc:
✨ NEW UPDATE: 
- RAID, Explore & Conquer!
- NEW ISLAND, NEW ROD, NEW SKILLS. 

🎣 Welcome to Fishing Master !
Embark on an epic fishing adventure inspired by “Câu Cá Vạn Cân”, also known as “Fishing for Ten Thousand Pounds.”

⚔️ Learn powerful fishing techniques and legendary skills.
🐟 Challenge gigantic fish weighing “Thousands Of Kilograms”.
🔥 Upgrade your strength, master new abilities, and become the ultimate Fishing Master!
🎁 Join the group to instantly receive an exclusive Fishing Rod Skin!

Are you ready to catch the biggest fish and become a true Fishing Master? 🌊🎣

FAQ:
- Weather spawns in the map every 30 mins / despawn after 10 mins.
- You need to unattach the skill book on old rod to attach it on new rod.
- More info in Discord servers.

⚠️ DO NOT EXPLOIT ! Once we have evidence that you exploited, we will not appeal the ban.
